assumptions: Normal-quality machines; no modules, beacons, or researched productivity bonuses.
Raw inputs are mined, harvested or pumped materials delivered at the factory boundary; mining and farming infrastructure is external.
All recipe unlocks and construction technologies must be researched by the player. No research is granted by these blueprints.
Rates are steady-state material balances. Rounded machine counts supply capacity; transport, spoilage, start-up and sustained rates require native tests.
Random recipe output affects the target dependency: no. Random surplus: jellynut-seed, yumako-seed.
Machine count includes 1 extra cells for conservative item-inserter capacity; recipe demand and external ingredients are unchanged.
objective: Weighted imports, active machine time and advanced-machine handling. Ordinary machines preferred; not a claim of global layout optimality.

warnings: Random result rates are expectations, not guaranteed yields. Native throughput needs repeated measurement windows; target randomness follows its actual selected-recipe dependencies.
Spoilage losses are not included in stoichiometric demand; measure them in the native run.
Burner fuel is included at active crafting consumption; idle fuel and spoilage can increase demand.

requiredResearch.policy: Required research listed for the player; blueprint import never grants it. Infinite productivity research excluded from the rate model.
